resources.string: Activity recognition helps the app understand whether you are walking, driving, or stationary, allowing automatic tracking to start and stop at the right times.
Location access is needed to track your position for fitness activities, travel logging, and showing your routes on the map.
Phone permission is needed for multi-SIM support to provide accurate cell network information.

Automatic tracking requires background location access to detect when you start moving and begin tracking your activities even when the app is closed. This helps provide seamless fitness and travel tracking.
